items.detail: FIFA president Gianni Infantino scrapped his proposal to sell stakes in the World Cup after widespread backlash, including from within global soccer's governing body, and a threatened boycott by European nations.

items.headline: Cunningham unconcerned about being a distraction
items.detail: Sophie Cunningham says she's unconcerned that the rallies against transgender participation in women's sports that have accompanied the Indiana Fever's recent games are a distraction for the WNBA team.

items.headline: DOJ to drop Reflecting Pool case vs. ex-Olympian
items.detail: The Justice Department on Friday acknowledged the damage to the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool was the result of a botched installation by a contractor and moved to dismiss its criminal case against former Olympian David Hearn.

items.headline: Skattebo admits doing 'dumb things,' but 'you learn'
items.detail: Giants running back Cam Skattebo admitted Friday to sometimes doing "dumb things," citing his recent backflip at Fanatics Fest, and said he met with coach John Harbaugh.

items.headline: Boston's Contreras exits after fastball clips helmet
items.detail: Red Sox first baseman Willson Contreras was struck on the side of his helmet by a 95 mph fastball in the third inning of Friday night's game against the Dodgers and left for precautionary reasons.

items.headline: Clark has 3 hits, RBI in MLB debut as Tigers coast
items.detail: The Detroit Tigers called up prized outfield prospect Max Clark from the minor leagues and scratched Casey Mize from his scheduled start as they began their final series before the trade deadline.

items.headline: Sparks' Plum on trade speculation: 'It's business'
items.detail: Five-time All-Star guard Kelsey Plum said she's "not taking anything personal" amid growing speculation that the Sparks could move her before Sunday's trade deadline

items.headline: Source: WNBA won't discipline Bueckers, Reese
items.detail: WNBA stars Paige Bueckers and Angel Reese will not be disciplined for what appeared to be a friendly wager ahead of Wednesday's matchup, a league source told ESPN.

items.headline: WNBA bars Storm co-owner for confronting fans
items.detail: The WNBA has suspended Seattle Storm co-owner Celeste Keaton from attending the team's next five home games after her exchange with two fans during Tuesday's matchup with the Fever.
